name: Personal research agent learning workflow
description: Checks first-module teaching and current-session continuation.

parts.text: Start with basic containers and command-line skills. Roadmap: containers, Kubernetes architecture, workloads, networking, storage, security, and operations. Module 1 explains containers and why Kubernetes manages them. Practice by running one container and inspecting it. Use the official Kubernetes Concepts and Docker Get Started guides. Ask for module 2 when ready.

The roadmap covers snapshots, commits, branches, remotes, and collaboration. Module 1 teaches repositories and snapshots with an official Git reference, a small local inspection exercise, and an invitation to ask for module 2.

Module 2 teaches commits only, using plain language, direct official links, and a small commit exercise. It does not repeat module 1 or teach later modules, and it ends by inviting the user to request module 3.
